what: The BuyrWorld calculation engine, vendored byte-for-byte.
why: Stage 5 says existing engines become capabilities and that watered-down copies must not be rebuilt.
BuyrFlow and buyrworld.com are separate repositories with no package manager between them, so consuming the engine means carrying these exact files.
They are never edited here. A fix belongs in buyrworld.com and arrives by re-vendoring.
resync: Copy src/calc/{exact,index-series,fx,cost-bridge}.mjs from the commit named above, then run node tools/engine-hashes.mjs to rewrite this file.
